entradas.text: I was travelling to the snow-covered city of Narbel in the Nargis region for the rural development forum organized by the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Education.
“We will be arriving at Hotel West in a few minutes, sir.”
“Can't say it's been a comfortable ride, Serge.”
entradas.menu: “Can't say it's been a comfortable ride, Serge.”

entradas.text: “Thank you for letting me know.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for letting me know.”

entradas.text: “Any time. It is my duty.”
“I am sorry sir. The roads here aren't the best.”
After a moment, Serge started to smile under his moustache.
“How is life, Serge?”
entradas.menu: “How is life, Serge?”

entradas.text: “Sir, I just want to say... It has been great these last two months.”
“As you know, my wife Suzan recently gave birth to our son. And now my daughter just started at a very good high school in Holsord."
“Congratulations.”
entradas.menu: “Congratulations.”

entradas.text: “Get ready, Serge. Because life is about to become a lot busier.”
entradas.menu: “Get ready, Serge. Because life is about to become a lot busier.”

entradas.text: “The doctors said he is very healthy and thankfully so is my wife.”
“But I shouldn't have made my insecurity get to me. Erica outsmarts me all the time. I'm very proud to have a daughter like her.”
“How are your children, sir, if I may ask?”
“Tell me more about Suzan. What kind of a person is she?”
entradas.menu: “Tell me more about Suzan. What kind of a person is she?”

entradas.text: “Why did you want another child?”
entradas.menu: “Why did you want another child?”

entradas.text: “Deana is as lively as ever, but Franc seems to be a little distant.”
entradas.menu: “Deana is as lively as ever, but Franc seems to be a little distant.”

entradas.text: “They are both doing just fine. Going through different phases in life.”
entradas.menu: “They are both doing just fine. Going through different phases in life.”

entradas.text: “So that means she must have gotten the smarts from her mother.”
entradas.menu: “So that means she must have gotten the smarts from her mother.”

entradas.text: “I too hope that Deana will grow to be like her mother someday.”
entradas.menu: “I also hope that Deana will grow to be like her mother someday.”

entradas.text: “Have I told you, sir? We named my son Georg.”
“Oh, I know, sir. It already is very busy. My daughter is a handful.”
“I appreciate it, sir. Truly. I was worried that I wouldn't be able to afford a good private school if she scored less in the entrance exams.”
“I come from a big family. I'm one of five siblings so having company is a constant in my life.”
“She's beautiful, of course. But what I really admire is her selflessness.”
“I can understand that completely, sir."
“That's very normal, sir. He is at that age. All of us went through a rebellious phase.”
The motorcade began approaching the hotel.
“I'm sure she will sir. After all she is the daughter of a lion and a lioness.”
“She must have!”
He let out a laugh.
“Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: “See you later, Serge.”
entradas.menu: “See you later, Serge.”

entradas.text: “Have a good day, Mr. President.”
“What's that smile for?”
entradas.menu: “What's that smile for?”

entradas.text: “That's good. I hope the hospital had a good service.”
entradas.menu: “That's good. I hope the hospital had a good service.”

entradas.text: “Normally, we would have been treated in one of the suburban hospitals.”
“But thanks to the special coverage of the presidential staff, we were transferred to Emerald State Hospital.”
“Glad that I could help.”
entradas.menu: “Glad that I could help.”

entradas.text: “We need to increase the quality of the services for all.”
entradas.menu: “We need to increase the quality of the services for all.”

entradas.text: “Emerald State is a great hospital.”
entradas.menu: “Emerald State is a great hospital.”

entradas.text: “You could call it a little traditional but it just feels right.”
“Sarna is a nice little city.”
entradas.menu: “Sarna is a nice little city.”

entradas.text: “Selflessness is a respectable trait to have.”
entradas.menu: “Selflessness is a respectable trait to have.”

entradas.text: “Monica is persevering. It can be inspiring at times to have a partner like that.”
entradas.menu: “Monica is persevering. It can be inspiring at times to have a partner like that.”

entradas.text: “Are you fine?”
entradas.menu: “Are you fine?”

entradas.text: “This is unacceptable. We need to invest in infrastructure here.”
entradas.menu: “This is unacceptable. We need to invest in infrastructure here.”

entradas.text: “I do not value insecurity in my employees, Serge.”
entradas.menu: “I do not value insecurity in my employees, Serge.”

entradas.text: “Yes, sir. I will be more careful from now on.”
“She is an inspiration for almost all women in the country.”
Serge sighed.
“Enough talking, Serge. Focus on the road.”
entradas.menu: “Enough talking, Serge. Focus on the road.”

entradas.text: “The bazaar there is quite unique and it is a good city. Nothing compares to Holsord of course.”
“It should be mutual, that is what matters most.”
“It's only fitting. A lioness for a lion.”
“The equipment and the staff were exceptional.”
“There are far more unfortunate people in this country. But thanks.”
“That sounds like a tough issue to solve.”
“I'm sorry. I will drive more carefully, sir.”
“I agree sir. We still need to drive back tomorrow unless you use one of those new helicopters.”
“Yes sir. I hope the car is fine too.”
The scenery so far, however, was a reflection of Narbel's neglect. The main roads to the city were not maintained well. There were many bumps and empty discolored spots in the asphalt.
The scenery so far, however, was a reflection of Narbel's neglect. The main roads to the city were not maintained well. There were many bumps and empty discolored spots in the asphalt.
Serge nodded.
“I expect so much from them. They will make me proud.”
entradas.menu: “I expect so much from them. They will make me proud.”

entradas.text: “It must not be easy to be the children of a high-profile person like you.”
“My daughter looks up to the First Lady for inspiration and it's not just limited to my daughter, sir.”
“It must be sir. We sometimes forget the important people in life between all the responsibility and rush.”
“You know... Those we care for...”
“I had some troubles communicating with Erica as she grew up, but we found a common ground by going to plays.”
“My children can talk to me if they want. It is up to them.”
entradas.menu: “My children can talk to me if they want. It is up to them.”

entradas.text: “Communication is the key.”
entradas.menu: “Communication is the key.”

entradas.text: “...I was unlucky. I never had a connection with my father. He was absent from our life, and I just can't have the same situation with my children...”
“Family is the cornerstone of life. We shouldn't forget that and it seems we do.”
entradas.menu: “Family is the cornerstone of life.”

entradas.text: “Traditional or not if it is what you want, that is all that matters.”
entradas.menu: “Traditional or not if it is what you want, that is all that matters.”

entradas.text: He glanced towards the back.
“I was never a family person.”
entradas.menu: “I was never a family person.”

entradas.text: “Yes and it depends on what type of environment it is. If its hostile...”
“We keep forgetting what we want and lose ourselves in the process.”
“You have a good family.”
“She has a good heart. Her family comes from Sarna, so they are a little more traditional.”
The mountainous city was infamously one of Sordland's poorest. It had a gritty edge, and its people were hardy and wary.

Even after the discovery of gas and oil in the area, years of neglect by the central government were apparent on the buildings and the general infrastructure. The natural resources were now under the control of Gasom, which elevated the corporation to a place of power.

My task in this forum was mainly symbolic. Fake smiles and handshakes with oil barons, meeting with local politicians, but most importantly of all, making sure that Narbel did not feel like it was forgotten by the government.
As if my discomfort from the bumpy ride was apparent to him, Serge rolled down the partition window.
“Good. Whatever gets us out of here quickly.”
entradas.menu: “Good. Whatever gets us out of here quickly.”

entradas.text: I let out a deep sigh.
I pretended not to notice and looked out the window.
entradas.menu: Pretend not to notice.

entradas.text: “Thankfully, my work times allow me to spend some time with my family, except for these distant trips. I'm very lucky to have this job.”
Serge continued after a moment of silence.
Navigating and swerving to avoid the inconveniences, our motorcade finally started nearing the city.
“They are fine, but that's not your business Serge.”
entradas.menu: “They are fine, but that's not your business Serge.”

entradas.text: “No sir. You are right, sir.”
He looked visibly irked by my comment and nodded.
“I expect you to do your job. Not ask questions about my private life.”
entradas.menu: “I expect you to do your job. Not ask questions about my private life.”

entradas.text: “It's okay.”
entradas.menu: “It's okay.”

entradas.text: “Understood, Mr. President.”
There was a long silence. After several minutes, Serge attempted to break silence.
There was a long silence. After several minutes, Serge attempted to break silence.
“Spare me your lectures, Serge.”
entradas.menu: “Spare me your lectures, Serge.”

entradas.text: “I agree.”
entradas.menu: “I agree.”

entradas.text: “Yes sir. I am sorry sir.”
“Spare me your lectures about parenthood, Serge.”
entradas.menu: “Spare me your lectures about parenthood, Serge.”

entradas.text: My thoughts faded to my childhood. My father was also absent from home most of the time. I never connected with him, just like Serge.
Being a president meant that I had to be away from home most of the time.
I wondered if Franc also thought of me as an absent father figure. Could that be the reason behind his attitude?
“But at the same time, it must be hard for the First Lady as well.”
“That is none of your business.”
entradas.menu: “That is none of your business.”

entradas.text: “You are right. It is hard for her.”
entradas.menu: “You are right. It is hard for her.”

entradas.text: “It is hard for both of us.”
entradas.menu: “It is hard for both of us.”

entradas.text: “My daughter looks up to the First Lady for inspiration. Not only my daughter, sir."
“All this attention, adjusting to this new high-profile life, and a husband that has great responsibility...”
“Very good. I must tend to my documents for a bit.”
entradas.menu: “Very good. I must tend to my documents for a bit.”

entradas.text: “Of course, Mr. President.”

The Hotel West was supposedly the best hotel in Narbel. The large 25-story main building was undoubtedly one of the taller and more expensive buildings in the city. It towered over the nearby slums and had been a target for protests when it was first built.
A crowd was gathered in front of the hotel with the welcoming committee at its centre. As we approached the red carpeted entrance I could see the Mayor of Narbel and his top aides.
Serge got out of the car and opened the door. He bowed his head respectfully and gestured towards the entrance.
“Thank you sir. Likewise.”
I gathered my documents, my bag and I left the car.
entradas.menu: Exit the vehicle.

entradas.text: As soon as I left the vehicle, the fresh air of Narbel filled my lungs.
Almost immediately, everyone present in the crowd flocked over to me with an excessive display of courtesy, smiles and handshakes while I donned the mask of a politician.
A mask that I was very used to.
The car hit a major pothole and a bump which lifted us up in our seats for a second.
“I've already started thinking about their university education. Especially Erica.”
“I want to send her to a good private school but with the current state of the economy, it's going to be hard for us.”
“We will fix the economy. One way or another.”
entradas.menu: “We will fix the economy. One way or another.”

entradas.text: “You know what? I can support the education of your children.”
entradas.menu: “You know what? I can support the education of your children." [-1 Personal Wealth]

entradas.text: “It's hard for everyone.”
entradas.menu: “It's hard for everyone.”

entradas.text: “Mr. President, there is no way I can--.”
With one look from me, Serge cut his sentence short and nodded at me after removing his hat.
“Mr. President, I don't know how I can ever repay you for this.”
“Thank you so much.”
“If anyone can, that's you, Mr. President.”
“If anyone can fix the economy, that's you, Mr. President.”
“A good education is more valuable than any amount of money.”
entradas.menu: “A good education is more valuable than any amount of money.”

entradas.text: “I hope you return the favor by helping someone in need someday. Just like I did.”
entradas.menu: “I hope you return the favor by helping someone in need someday. Just like I did.”

entradas.text: “I will, sir. Of course.”
“No worries, Serge.”
entradas.menu: “No worries, Serge.”

entradas.text: “Exactly, sir. You are right.”
“I think I have decided. I will give your name to my boy. ”
“Georg Anton Wolkner.”
“May he grow strong like you.”
“It has a nice ring to it. I like it.”
entradas.menu: “It has a nice ring to it. I like it.”

entradas.text: “I am sure he will.”
entradas.menu: “I am sure he will.”

entradas.text: I nodded.
entradas.menu: Nod.

entradas.text: The scenery so far, however, was a reflection of Narbel's neglect. The main roads to the city were not maintained well. There were many bumps and empty discolored spots in the asphalt.
“That's great news, Serge. I'm happy for you.”
entradas.menu: “That's great news, Serge. I'm happy for you.”

entradas.text: “You are a good father, Serge."
entradas.menu: “You are a good father, Serge."

entradas.text: “I try my best, sir.”
"It is."
“Let's not talk about my family, Serge.”
entradas.menu: “Let's not talk about my family, Serge.”

entradas.text: “Yes, Serge. I get it...”
entradas.menu: “Yes, Serge. I get it...”

entradas.text: “Of course, sir.”
“My driver's family shouldn't want for anything in this world. I'll cover your children's education and any other extra expenses you need."
entradas.menu: “My driver's family shouldn't want for anything in this world. I'll cover your children's education and any other extra expenses you need." [-2 Personal Wealth]

entradas.text: “I won't forget your generosity, sir.”
